desenho: Pre-declared design note, section D-T3 (closing rule: runs once; the result goes into the text as it comes out)

operacionalizacao.A_e_e_modelo: shifted by -(off_arm[t] - off_i[t]) per anchor cell (dA/do=-1); delta intact; A-delta = A_arm - delta
operacionalizacao.estatistica: ARV2.estimando_unidade / mae_reducao_unidade with the SAME bootstrap tags as v2 in all records (same unit draws); B=10000, seed 42, clustered by unit
operacionalizacao.teto_familias: max(|lo|,|hi|) of the bootstrap 95% CI of the median of the v23-mlp dMAE per unit (REF.testar; floor of 200 cells, >=6 units), forest-judgeable population from REF.montar_populacao with z_ref = z_solo_v2 + off_arm; primary = transect ceiling in both units; secondary = ceiling recomputed in the footprint unit
operacionalizacao.O3: O3 not applied: S7 missing (auditar_s7_arvore_lidar.json does not exist)
